experiments.question: Which fields correlate pool waits with inventory requests?

answer.documented_evidence: Correlating slow inventory calls with long checkouts to test whether a code path holds a connection while waiting on a dependency is supported by inspecting active and long-running transaction durations, connection checkout duration, and recent request concurrency [c-b558d4a54b99f92199c0a0f0]. The field inventory_request_ms measures elapsed client time for an inventory request [c-0f45ebfa20d4d867d43eff2a]. Meanwhile, db_pool_waiters counts pending acquisitions and db_pool_acquire_ms measures time spent waiting for a pool slot [c-86a311dbd0dd4b58d0c0fe02].

experiments.experiment: direct-answer schema description only; original v2 system/message layout/model/settings and recorded q08 evidence
experiments.question: Which fields correlate pool waits with inventory requests?

answer.documented_evidence: The available documents do not name a single combined field that directly correlates pool waits with inventory requests, but slow inventory calls can be correlated with long checkouts to test whether a code path holds a connection while waiting on a dependency [c-b558d4a54b99f92199c0a0f0]. The telemetry fields involved in database pool waits include db_pool_in_use (the number of checked-out connections in one process), db_pool_waiters (counts pending acquisitions), and db_pool_acquire_ms (measures time spent waiting for a slot) [c-86a311dbd0dd4b58d0c0fe02]. The fields associated with inventory requests include inventory_request_ms (measures elapsed client time for an inventory request), dependency_name (identifies the upstream), and upstream_status (the received HTTP status when available) [c-0f45ebfa20d4d867d43eff2a]. Additionally, request_id and trace_id serve as correlation identifiers to connect signals in the same time window and process [c-86a311dbd0dd4b58d0c0fe02, c-8eb6f00c104ca799f19afdbf].
answer.recommended_checks: Correlate slow inventory calls with long checkouts to test whether a code path holds a connection while waiting on a dependency [c-b558d4a54b99f92199c0a0f0]. Inspect dependency_name, upstream_status, inventory_request_ms and trace spans for the same request_id and time window [c-8eb6f00c104ca799f19afdbf]. Compare db_pool_in_use with the per-process limit of 20, db_pool_waiters, and db_pool_acquire_ms for the same process and time window [c-8b07e11e14a4069f84d9dc0f].
